name: @veren/im-bundle
description: Use when a DSH host needs instant-messaging capability: this configuration-only bundle mounts the provider-neutral IM core (accounts, people directory, stranger intake, active-binding routing), the model-facing im_* tools, the WeChat iLink channel, and the web panel (in-page QR bind, bindings, people, intake audit) as one installable profile layer.
_comment_dependencies: Member packages use workspace ranges; a release publishes the whole line at one version. testkit is deliberately absent: it is a vitest library, not a plugin, and must never enter the publish closure.
